description: Says which claims SkeptOpus can verify in a folder before you rely on it: whether a test command and measurements are declared, which repositories it will ask. A claim it cannot verify comes back COULD_NOT_CHECK. Changes nothing.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the project folder to look at. Always pass it: some editors start this server in the home folder.
